recipe.title: Beef, barley and Brussels sprout pot
recipe.intro: Sprouts are coming into their own in early November. Halved and stirred in at the end, they stay green and nutty in this filling beef and barley pot.
utensils: large casserole or deep pan with a lid
steps: Heat the oil in a large casserole over a high heat. Add the mince and fry for 6 to 8 minutes, breaking it up with a wooden spoon, until well browned and any liquid has cooked off.
Turn the heat to medium, add the onion and carrots and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then, until the onion is soft and golden.
Stir in the garlic, thyme leaves and tomato purée and cook for 1 minute, until the purée darkens a little.
Add the barley and hot stock, season with salt and pepper and bring to the boil. Cover, turn down low and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring once or twice so nothing sticks.
Stir in the sprouts, adding a splash of water if the pot looks dry. Cook uncovered for 10 to 12 minutes, until the barley is tender with a slight chew and the sprouts are bright green and just soft.
Taste for seasoning, then leave to stand for 5 minutes before spooning into warm bowls.
recipe.tip: Leftovers keep in the fridge for 2 days. Add a splash of water when reheating, as the barley soaks up the liquid.
